verdict_summary: T5R-01's two blocking items are substantively fixed and independently reproduced (exec bit delivered three-way; external-pin three-way equality rejects a self-consistent forger that recomputes its own hash). A1/A2/A3/A-common now PASS(CONTRACT). All six prior advisories are closed with verifiable artifacts. One blocking remains: the headline delivery claim (21/21 x2 = 42/42) is still not reproducible from the delivered package state - the delivered probe entry point fails P01 as delivered, and the only replay path overwrites a manifest-hash-bound raw record, contradicting the package's own FP-RAW-RECORD-INTEGRITY declaration. Same defect class and same affected claim as T5R-01 BLOCKING-1, so the same verdict standard applies. Fix is local, cheap and needs no authority expansion.
